questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese (example: Ask him/her to wait a moment -> Chotto matte kudasai. / Chotto matte kudasaimasen ka?). Cue: Ask (him/her) to come with you.

answers.answer_text: Chotto issho ni kite kudasai. (OR Chotto issho ni kite kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to repeat.

answers.answer_text: Moo ichido itte kudasai. (OR Moo ichido itte kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to buy a meal ticket.

answers.answer_text: Shokken o katte kudasai. (OR Shokken o katte kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to buy a (train) ticket.

answers.answer_text: Kippu o katte kudasai. (OR Kippu o katte kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to repeat slowly.

answers.answer_text: Yukkuri itte kudasai. (OR Yukkuri itte kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to write here.

answers.answer_text: Koko ni kaite kudasai. (OR Koko ni kaite kudasaimasen ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Make the request in Japanese. Cue: Ask (him/her) to show it to you.
